title: Verify: Vite publicDir and BootScene PNG preload without fallback
summary: Unit tests for publicDir, preload calls, resolveKey and animation creation with Phaser mocked
description: Phaser is mocked as in bootScenePreload.test.ts; the real manifest and scene are used.

steps.action: Import default config from '../vite.config' and expect config.publicDir (normalised slashes) to end with '/game/public'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/viteConfig.test.ts

steps.action: Copy the phaser vi.mock and graphics helper from tests/bootScenePreload.test.ts but do not mock '../src/runtime/content'. Tests: (1) preload() calls load.image with ('room/wall', 'assets/worlds/the-boys-room/room/wall.png') and load.spritesheet with ('character:boy-sheet', 'assets/worlds/the-boys-room/characters/boy-sheet.png', {frameWidth:32, frameHeight:48}); (2) no load call path ends '.svg'; (3) for every asset id in planPreload(scene, manifest).load, scene.resolveKey(id) equals id, not FALLBACK_KEY; (4) with a mocked anims.create, ensureAnim for character:boy-sheet idle, walk, interact receives generateFrameNumbers frames arrays of length 4, 6 and 4 and repeat 0 for interact.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootScenePngPreload.test.ts
